1.12 [...] ## Revenue

During the second quarter of the fiscal year 2026 (Q2FY26), Medi Assist Healthcare Services Ltd reported a total income of ₹234.82 crores. This marks a significant increase of 18.6% quarter-over-quarter (QoQ) from ₹197.95 crores in Q1FY26 and a 25.5% year-over-year (YoY) rise compared to ₹187.14 crores in Q2FY25. The robust growth in total income indicates the company's ability to enhance its revenue base consistently over the comparable periods.

## Profitability [...] ## Profitability

In Q2FY26, Medi Assist Healthcare Services Ltd experienced a decline in profitability, with its profit before tax (PBT) decreasing to ₹13.47 crores from ₹30.51 crores in Q1FY26, reflecting a 55.9% QoQ drop. Similarly, the YoY comparison shows a 54.3% decrease from ₹29.49 crores in Q2FY25. The company's profit after tax (PAT) also declined significantly to ₹8.07 crores, a 64.3% QoQ and 61.6% YoY reduction from ₹22.63 crores in Q1FY26 and ₹21.01 crores in Q2FY25, respectively. Earnings per Share (EPS) followed the same downward trend, reducing to ₹1.12 from ₹3.16 in Q1FY26 and ₹2.97 in Q2FY25.
